name: The Castaway Story
source: It has a simple setting. While enjoying the vacation on the yacht, the yacht was hit by a storm. Our protagonist and other survivors ended up on a remote island not seen before. Uncover the dark and dirty secrets of the island along with romancing both survivors and natives of the island.​
translation: 故事设定很简单。主角乘游艇度假时，游艇遭遇了暴风雨。他与其他幸存者漂流到一座从未见过的偏远岛屿上。揭开岛上黑暗肮脏的秘密，同时与幸存者和当地居民发展恋情。
